items.title: How a U.S. diesel export ban would play out, according to Goldman Sachs
items.description: Strategists at Goldman Sachs see potential restrictions on U.S. diesel exports adding $0.30 per gallon to domestic retail gasoline prices

items.title: ‘I feel like he’s holding me back’: I have $8 million. My husband resents my success. Should I pay for more things?
items.description: “I’d rather be on a beach in Bali than watching my spouse sit at the computer.”

items.title: Simone Biles and Jonathan Owens list  a $1.2 million Texas home near Houston
items.description: Olympic gymnast Simone Biles and her NFL star husband, Jonathan Owens, are bidding farewell to the Texas home they lived in while putting the finishing touches on their custom-built dream mansion.

items.title: ‘Sex and the City’ star Chris Noth is selling his ‘breathtaking’ Greenwich Village apartment for $1.5 million
items.description: “Sex and the City” star Chris Noth is moving on from his longtime New York City apartment, listing the luxe Greenwich Village dwelling for nearly $1.5 million.

items.title: ‘I want to make her proud’: My mother, a divorcée, died and I’m her executor. Do I need to file for probate?
items.description: “The only debts were utility and credit-card bills, which we will pay off.”

items.title: ‘We lived within our means’: I earned $30,000 as a pastor and still retired comfortably. Why don’t you tell people that?
items.description: “As a country, we have grown dangerously comfortable.”

items.title: A ‘death cross’ is coming for the dollar. Why Trump will be happy.
items.description: Don’t look now, but there are some technical reasons to believe that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was right when he declared to the financial markets that “I am the house now.”

items.title: Social Security overpaid my 82-year-old mother by $20,000. What else is hiding in her finances?
items.description: “My mother has a pension, Social Security, investments and a house probably worth over $1 million.”

items.title: My husband and I are in our 50s and have no kids. We have $2 million in IRAs and 401(k)s. Do we really need a will?
items.description: “We have no debt and own our primary home, a vacation home, as well as my mother’s home in another state.”

items.title: ‘It doesn’t seem fair’: I’m retired and have plenty of money. Why can’t I qualify for a retail credit card?
items.description: “I draw from my IRA as needed for household repairs, trips and other larger expenses.”
